cash_closure_debts_shape_valid.name: cash_closure_debts_shape_valid
cash_closure_debts_shape_valid.value:
"cash_closure_debts"."debt_type" IN ('pendiente', 'colaborador')
        AND "cash_closure_debts"."amount_clp" > 0
        AND (
          (
            "cash_closure_debts"."debt_type" = 'pendiente'
            AND "cash_closure_debts"."debt_note" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("cash_closure_debts"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            AND "cash_closure_debts"."debtor_collaborator" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            "cash_closure_debts"."debt_type" = 'colaborador'
            AND "cash_closure_debts"."debtor_collaborator" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("cash_closure_debts"."debtor_collaborator")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND (
              "cash_closure_debts"."debt_note" IS NULL
              OR length(trim("cash_closure_debts"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            )
          )
        )

cash_closure_expenses_shape_valid.name: cash_closure_expenses_shape_valid
cash_closure_expenses_shape_valid.value:
length(trim("cash_closure_expenses"."id")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND length(trim("cash_closure_expenses"."description")) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND "cash_closure_expenses"."amount_clp" > 0

cash_closure_inventory_shape_valid.name: cash_closure_inventory_shape_valid
cash_closure_inventory_shape_valid.value:
"cash_closure_inventory"."item_type" IN ('product', 'ingredient')
        AND "cash_closure_inventory"."location" IN ('simple', 'vitrina', 'bodega', 'ingredient')
        AND length("cash_closure_inventory"."expected_version_token") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND "cash_closure_inventory"."expected_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_inventory"."counted_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_inventory"."difference_quantity" = "cash_closure_inventory"."counted_quantity" - "cash_closure_inventory"."expected_quantity"
        AND (
          ("cash_closure_inventory"."difference_quantity" = 0 AND "cash_closure_inventory"."reason" IS NULL)
          OR (
            "cash_closure_inventory"."difference_quantity" <> 0
            AND "cash_closure_inventory"."reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("cash_closure_inventory"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
          )
        )

cash_closure_revision_inventory_shape_va.name: cash_closure_revision_inventory_shape_valid
cash_closure_revision_inventory_shape_va.value:
"cash_closure_revision_inventory"."item_type" IN ('product', 'ingredient')
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."location" IN ('simple', 'vitrina', 'ingredient')
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."previous_expected_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."expected_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."sale_consumption_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."expected_quantity" = "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."previous_expected_quantity" - "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."sale_consumption_quantity"
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."previous_counted_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_quantity" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_delta_quantity" = "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_quantity" - "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."previous_counted_quantity"
        AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."difference_quantity" = "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_quantity" - "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."expected_quantity"
        AND (
          ("cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_delta_quantity" = 0
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_before" IS NULL
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_version_token_before" IS NULL
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_after" IS NULL
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_version_token_after" IS NULL)
          OR
          ("cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_delta_quantity" <> 0
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_before" >= 0
            AND length("cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_version_token_before") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_after" = "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_before" + "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."counted_delta_quantity"
            AND "cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_quantity_after" >= 0
            AND length("cash_closure_revision_inventory"."live_version_token_after") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        )

cash_closure_revisions_shape_valid.name: cash_closure_revisions_shape_valid
cash_closure_revisions_shape_valid.value:
"cash_closure_revisions"."revision_number" = "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_revision_number" + 1
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."revision_number" BETWEEN 1 AND 50
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_revision_number" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_added_sales_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_inventory_line_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 90
        AND length("cash_closure_revisions"."request_fingerprint") = 64
        AND length(trim("cash_closure_revisions"."reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."included_sales_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."included_sales_count" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."opening_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."cash_collected_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."card_collected_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."transfer_collected_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."total_collected_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."cash_collected_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."card_collected_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."transfer_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_cash_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."opening_cash_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."cash_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_collected_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."opening_cash_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."total_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."expenses_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."adjusted_expected_cash_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."expected_cash_clp" - "cash_closure_revisions"."expenses_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."adjusted_expected_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_card_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_transfer_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_collected_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_cash_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_card_clp" + "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_transfer_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."difference_cash_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_cash_clp" - "cash_closure_revisions"."adjusted_expected_cash_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."difference_card_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_card_clp" - "cash_closure_revisions"."card_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."difference_transfer_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_transfer_clp" - "cash_closure_revisions"."transfer_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closure_revisions"."difference_collected_clp" = "cash_closure_revisions"."counted_collected_clp" - ("cash_closure_revisions"."expected_collected_clp" - "cash_closure_revisions"."expenses_clp")

cash_closures_context_valid.name: cash_closures_context_valid
cash_closures_context_valid.value:
"cash_closures"."business_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
        AND "cash_closures"."shift" IN ('am', 'pm')
        AND length(trim("cash_closures"."responsible")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100

cash_closures_nonnegative.name: cash_closures_nonnegative
cash_closures_nonnegative.value:
"cash_closures"."expected_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."expected_card_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."expected_transfer_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."expected_collected_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."total_sales_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."sales_count" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."pending_customer_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."collaborator_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."unassigned_sales_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."unassigned_sales_count" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."unassigned_payments_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."unassigned_payments_count" >= 0

cash_closures_formal_state_valid.name: cash_closures_formal_state_valid
cash_closures_formal_state_valid.value:
(
        "cash_closures"."session_id" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."session_activity_revision" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."opening_cash_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."cash_movements_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."pending_customer_count" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."collaborator_count" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_card_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_card_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_transfer_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_transfer_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_collected_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_collected_clp" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."financial_difference_reason" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."cash_reconciled" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."card_reconciled" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."transfer_reconciled" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."pending_customer_reviewed" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."collaborator_reviewed" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."inventory_count_confirmed" IS NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."checklist_version" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "cash_closures"."session_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "cash_closures"."session_activity_revision" >= 0
        AND length("cash_closures"."request_fingerprint") = 64
        AND "cash_closures"."opening_cash_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."cash_movements_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."expected_cash_clp" = "cash_closures"."opening_cash_clp" + "cash_closures"."cash_movements_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."pending_customer_count" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."collaborator_count" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_card_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_card_clp" = "cash_closures"."counted_card_clp" - "cash_closures"."expected_card_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_transfer_clp" >= 0
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_transfer_clp" = "cash_closures"."counted_transfer_clp" - "cash_closures"."expected_transfer_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."counted_collected_clp" = "cash_closures"."counted_cash_clp" + "cash_closures"."counted_card_clp" + "cash_closures"."counted_transfer_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_collected_clp" = "cash_closures"."counted_collected_clp" - "cash_closures"."expected_collected_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."difference_collected_clp" = "cash_closures"."difference_clp" + "cash_closures"."difference_card_clp" + "cash_closures"."difference_transfer_clp"
        AND "cash_closures"."cash_reconciled" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."card_reconciled" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."transfer_reconciled" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."pending_customer_reviewed" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."collaborator_reviewed" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."inventory_count_confirmed" = 1
        AND "cash_closures"."checklist_version" = 1
        AND (
          (
            "cash_closures"."difference_clp" = 0
            AND "cash_closures"."difference_card_clp" = 0
            AND "cash_closures"."difference_transfer_clp" = 0
            AND "cash_closures"."financial_difference_reason" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            (
              "cash_closures"."difference_clp" <> 0
              OR "cash_closures"."difference_card_clp" <> 0
              OR "cash_closures"."difference_transfer_clp" <> 0
            )
            AND "cash_closures"."financial_difference_reason" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("cash_closures"."financial_difference_reason")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
          )
        )
      )

products_stock_shape_valid.name: products_stock_shape_valid
products_stock_shape_valid.value:
(
        "products"."stock_mode" = 'untracked'
        AND "products"."stock" IS NULL
        AND "products"."stock_vitrina" IS NULL
        AND "products"."stock_bodega" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "products"."stock_mode" = 'simple'
        AND "products"."stock" IS NOT NULL
        AND "products"."stock" >= 0
        AND "products"."stock_vitrina" IS NULL
        AND "products"."stock_bodega" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "products"."stock_mode" = 'split'
        AND "products"."stock" IS NULL
        AND "products"."stock_vitrina" IS NOT NULL
        AND "products"."stock_vitrina" >= 0
        AND "products"."stock_bodega" IS NOT NULL
        AND "products"."stock_bodega" >= 0
      )

sale_payments_context_valid.name: sale_payments_context_valid
sale_payments_context_valid.value:
(
        "sale_payments"."business_date" IS NULL
        AND "sale_payments"."shift" IS NULL
        AND "sale_payments"."received_by" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "sale_payments"."business_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
        AND "sale_payments"."shift" IN ('am', 'pm')
        AND "sale_payments"."received_by" IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim("sale_payments"."received_by")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
      )

sales_shift_context_valid.name: sales_shift_context_valid

sales_payment_state_valid.name: sales_payment_state_valid
sales_payment_state_valid.value:
(
        "sales"."payment_status" = 'pending'
        AND "sales"."payment_method" IS NULL
        AND "sales"."paid_at" IS NULL
        AND "sales"."settlement_id" IS NULL
        AND (
          (
            "sales"."checkout_method" = 'pendiente'
            AND "sales"."debt_note" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("sales"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            AND "sales"."debtor_collaborator" IS NULL
          ) OR (
            "sales"."checkout_method" = 'colaborador'
            AND "sales"."debtor_collaborator" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("sales"."debtor_collaborator")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND (
              "sales"."debt_note" IS NULL
              OR length(trim("sales"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            )
          )
        )
      ) OR (
        "sales"."payment_status" = 'paid'
        AND "sales"."payment_method" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales"."payment_method" IN ('efectivo', 'tarjeta', 'debito', 'credito', 'transferencia')
        AND "sales"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
          (
            "sales"."checkout_method" IN ('efectivo', 'tarjeta', 'transferencia')
            AND "sales"."debt_note" IS NULL
            AND "sales"."debtor_collaborator" IS NULL
            AND "sales"."settlement_id" IS NULL
          )
          OR (
            "sales"."checkout_method" = 'pendiente'
            AND "sales"."debt_note" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("sales"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            AND "sales"."debtor_collaborator" IS NULL
            AND "sales"."settlement_id" IS NOT NULL
          )
          OR (
            "sales"."checkout_method" = 'colaborador'
            AND "sales"."debtor_collaborator" IS NOT NULL
            AND length(trim("sales"."debtor_collaborator")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
            AND (
              "sales"."debt_note" IS NULL
              OR length(trim("sales"."debt_note")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500
            )
            AND "sales"."settlement_id" IS NOT NULL
          )
        )
      )

shift_sessions_context_valid.name: shift_sessions_context_valid
shift_sessions_context_valid.value:
"shift_sessions"."business_date" GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'
        AND "shift_sessions"."shift" IN ('am', 'pm')
        AND length(trim("shift_sessions"."responsible")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100

shift_sessions_state_valid.name: shift_sessions_state_valid
shift_sessions_state_valid.value:
(
        "shift_sessions"."status" = 'open'
        AND "shift_sessions"."active_slot" = 1
        AND "shift_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL
        AND "shift_sessions"."closure_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "shift_sessions"."status" = 'closed'
        AND "shift_sessions"."active_slot" IS NULL
        AND "shift_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "shift_sessions"."closure_id" IS NOT NULL
      )
